᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼[b] FOR ROCK AND STONE! [/b]

TL;DR: ROCK AND STONE. One of the best coop shooters on the market right now. It's really fun to play with your friends or even strangers, because the community is really cool and chill. I definitely recommend to play DRG.

[hr] [/hr]
[h1]᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼DWARVEN MIRACLE [/h1]

Who could've thought drinking beer in a videogame would be fun? That's DRG for you — even the most basic of activities like drinking beer, kicking a barrel, or scanning mushroom again and again, are not boring. I wish there were more games like DRG — games that are created with true passion, not because of corporate greed and corruption. 

To sum up the plot of DRG — you play as dwarves (they work for some corporation) that are launching mining missions on the planet Hoxxes IV. You exterminate bugs and rivals in the process, becasue they're in your way, and Mission Control helps you to achieve the operation's goals. Oh, and there's Karl - the legendary Dwarf who, according to legends, fought the Bug Queen on his own and their skirmish destroyed a good chunk (1/4 I guess?) of the planet and you can see the aftermath right from the Space Rig you spawn in. That's neat. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3433241788

[hr] [/hr]
[h1] ᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼PROS [/h1]

✅Gameplay. This game is really fun. You can choose 4 classes: scout, engineer, gunner and driller, each with their own unique upgrades, equipment and abilities. Each of them has their own gameplay and gunplay. You fight various enemies: from glyphids (bugs) to rivals (robots), airborne and ground, and sometimes you even battle with your fellow dwarves because of friendly fire. You can play solo if you really want to - you'll be accompanied by a flying drone BOSCO ( [spoiler] BOSCO, READY TO GO! I LOVE BOSCO! [/spoiler] ). But I think DRG really shines when you play with friends, because the game becomes the virtual embodiment of chaos and fun! Sometimes you won't even understand what is happening on the screen, but you'll be laughing and screaming like never before in your life! 
The missions are diverse as well, and that makes the game really addicting even after ~300 hours, because you never get bored. This is a huge W for the developers. I salute them. 
Oh, have I mentioned that you can play the missions while drunk as hell? Yeah, you can do that in DRG. This is hella hard, but really funny. 

✅Community. DRG has one of the most friendly communities I've ever seen and interacted with. Some players might disagree with me, but as a newbie I often met high-prestige players (DRG pros basically) who would lend a helping hand and explain some game mechanics to me without being choking and toxic. DRG players have a universal friendly sign - V button. [b] Trust me, pressing it is fun even after you've done it a hundred thousand times. [/b] It gives a strange feeling of unity, and you feel one with the dwarves and the community. I absolutely adore it.  [i] FOR ROCK AND STONE! [/i]

✅Performance and optimization. This game has no issues with optimization, even on older PCs. It looks great even on low-medium graphics settings, and the FPS counter only drops a little when there are literally hundreds of enemies. There is DLSS as well, so RTX cards users will be delighted.

✅Atmosphere and visuals. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2998417217

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3433241855

I think those two screenshots speak for themselves. The graphics and atmosphere possess undescribable beauty.

✅Soundtrack. The DRG OST is really good, it varies from calm ambience to blood-pumping adrenaline rush tracks. I highly recommend you to check it, especially "RUN!" (my favorite one). 

✅Mod support. DRG has an official mod support, which you can access in-game. Nuff said.

[h1] ᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼CONS [/h1]

⛔Lack of content. DRG doesn't receive content updates often. (There's still lots of hotfixes and patches, because Ghost Ship Games actually cares about DRG's well-being) I have to admit that content updates are rare yet huge, and there's lots to do in the game, but I really wish the updates were more frequent, so that player base would be bigger and game even more fun than it already is. 

⛔FOMO. There's lots of limited time stuff, like Lunar Festival, Halloween and such. This is tremendously irritating for players who don't really play often (like me, for example).

[hr] [/hr]

[h1] ᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼᲼CONCLUSION [/h1]

I rate this game 9/10. Deep Rock Galactic is a great coop-shooter, and it deserves every praise it gets. I still have lots of fun hopping on DRG with friends and just having a good time.
ROCK AND STONE TO THE BONE
Should be called Deep Rock Galctica
